title: Fading Hopes, Rising Needs - Renewed Fighting Threatens Another Humanitarian Catastrophe in Tigray
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Renewed fighting in Tigray, northern Ethiopia, is pushing an already vulnerable population towards another humanitarian catastrophe. Nearly four years after the November 2022 Pretoria peace agreement was signed to end the devastating war between the Ethiopian federal government and Tigrayan forces, renewed hostilities have raised serious concerns about civilian safety, mass displacement, food insecurity, and the disruption of essential services.

title: As Tens of Thousands Flee Ethiopia to Kenya, UN Agency Warns of Growing Humanitarian Needs
summary: [allAfrica] Geneva -- The UN Refugee Agency (UNHCR) says humanitarian needs are growing in an unfolding crisis on the Kenya-Ethiopia border as ongoing clashes on the Ethiopian side have forced tens of thousands of people to cross into Kenya in search of safety.

title: PM Abiy Invites Russian Institutions to Partner With Ethiopia's AI University
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has called for deeper scientific cooperation with Russia, specifically inviting Russian institutions to partner with Ethiopia's newly established Medemer University of Artificial Intelligence.

title: Putin Hails Ethiopia-Russia Trade Surge to $1.3 Billion
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Russian President Vladimir Putin has hailed the sharp growth in bilateral trade between Russia and Ethiopia, which exceeded 1.3 billion USD in the first nine months of 2026.

title: Green Initiatives in Ethiopia Catalyst to Drive Climate Action Across Africa - UN-Habitat Official
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Ethiopia's green development initiatives provide a practical lesson for African countries seeking to reduce emissions and advance climate action, UN-Habitat Regional Office for Africa Director Oumar Sylla said.

title: Ethiopia-Russia Strategic Partnership Will Diversify Energy Options - PM Abiy
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Prime Minister Abiy said that the strategic partnership between Ethiopia and Russia will diversify energy options, accelerate Ethiopia's prosperity, and strengthen the bilateral bond more than ever.

title: Ethiopian Arrivals Fleeing Moyale Conflict Into Northern Kenya Rise to Nearly 50,000 - 'Situation Remains Fluid': UN
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Approximately 50,000 people have crossed from Ethiopia into northern Kenya following violent clashes around Moyale, with the International Organization for Migration (IOM) warning that further arrivals could overwhelm already strained local services and resources.

title: Drone Strike Kills 16, Injures 22 At Hayiq Jari 2 IDP Camp in Amhara Region
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- A drone strike killed 16 civilians and injured 22 others at the Hayiq Jari 2 Turk internally displaced persons (IDP) camp in Amhara region at around 11:00 a.m. today, including three pregnant women, an eight-year-old girl and students, camp residents told Addis Standard.

title: Sudan Accuses Ethiopia of Launching 162 Drone Attacks From Its Territory
summary: [Dabanga] Khartoum -- Sudan says 162 drone attacks launched from Ethiopian territory have killed more than 400 civilians and 102 military personnel, amid accusations that Ethiopia is supporting the Rapid Support Forces (RSF). The claims have not been independently verified.

title: Dangote Hires Spanish Firm for Ethiopia's $4 Billion Fertiliser Project
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Dangote Group, owned by Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote, has contracted Spanish engineering company Técnicas Reunidas to supply two hydrogen reformers for its fertiliser plant under construction in Gode, Somali region, as the project's estimated cost rises to more than $4 billion.

title: The Corridor We Must Force Open - a Tigrayan Woman's Reckoning
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Tigray endured more than a war. It endured a devastating test of its social, economic, and political foundations, and that test revealed a painful truth: while our communities drew on extraordinary reserves of solidarity, our systems of governance were not prepared to protect them.

title: Abiy, Putin Discuss Nuclear Energy, Trade Cooperation At Moscow Summit
summary: [Horn Diplomat] Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed held talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin on Thursday on expanding cooperation in nuclear energy, health and trade, a day after attending a Kremlin banquet with First Lady Zinash Tayachew.

title: Former PM Hailemariam Says Ethiopia's Pursuit of Sea Access Rational
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Ethiopia's pursuit of sustainable sea access is a rational and undeniable national aspiration that should be addressed through dialogue and negotiations, former Prime Minister Hailemariam Desalegn said.

title: Sudan Once Again Accuses Ethiopia of Involvement in Drone Strikes Targeting Power Stations, Civilian Sites
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Sudan has once again accused neighbouring Ethiopia of involvement in drone attacks targeting civilian infrastructure, fuel depots and power stations, alleging that drones used in recent strikes were launched from Ethiopian territory, including Bahir Dar Airport.

title: Uganda Embassy in Addis Ababa Backs IACO's New AU Office, Continental Coffee Strategy
summary: [Independent (Kampala)] Addis Ababa, Ethiopia -- The Uganda Embassy in Addis Ababa has expressed strong support for the Inter-African Coffee Organisation (IACO) and its newly opened office at the African Union headquarters, reaffirming Uganda's commitment to a continental strategy aimed at transforming Africa's coffee sector.

title: PM Abiy Says Newly Acquired Defense Systems Boost Ethiopia's Strategic Deterrence
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has emphasized that Ethiopia's latest acquisition of advanced military hardware will substantially bolster the nation's defensive capabilities.

title: Ethiopia Steps Up Water Resource Mapping Amid Growing Demand
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Ethiopia is strengthening efforts to identify, document, and manage its surface and groundwater resources as rapid population growth, industrialization, and agricultural expansion drive up national demand for water, according to a senior expert at the Ministry of Water and Energy (MoWE).

title: Ethiopia Receives 12 Russian SU-35 Fighter Jets, Plans to Acquire Four S-400 Air Defense Batteries
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed said Ethiopia has taken delivery of 12 Russian-made Su-35 fighter jets and will receive four S-400 air defense system batteries, announcing a significant expansion of the country's military capabilities amid growing security concerns in the Horn of Africa.

title: Five Farmers Killed, Over 100 Cattle Looted in South Ethiopia's Burji Zone - Three More Killed in Kore
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Five farmers were killed and more than 100 cattle looted in an attack in Soyama Zuria Woreda of the Burji Zone in South Ethiopia Regional State on 22 October, according to local sources who spoke with Addis Standard; three more people, including a 14-year-old boy, were also killed in a separate attack in neighboring Kore Zone, two days later.

title: More Than 50 Detained After Burying Victims of Deadly Attacks On Orthodox Faithful in Ethiopia's Oromia
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- More than 50 residents in Shirka Woreda, Southeast Zone (formerly Arsi zone) of Oromia region, have reportedly been detained after burying victims of recent attacks and assisting the wounded, residents told Addis Standard, raising concerns about a security crackdown in the aftermath of the killings.

title: Russia Repeats Offer to Host Ethiopia-Eritrea Dialogue, PM Abiy Arrives in Moscow for Africa Summit
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Russia has reiterated its readiness to facilitate dialogue between Ethiopia and Eritrea, offering Moscow as a neutral venue for talks as Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed arrives in the Russian capital to attend the third Russia-Africa Summit.

title: Seven Former Ethiopian Diplomats Urge U.S. to Distinguish Opposition Alliance From Separatist Movements
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Seven former Ethiopian diplomats, including former Foreign Affairs Minister Gedu Andargachew, have urged US Secretary of State Marco Rubio to distinguish opposition to Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed's government from separatist objectives, warning that Washington's characterization of an opposition alliance risks oversimplifying Ethiopia's political and security crisis.

title: Gateway to Shared Prosperity, Not Territorial Rivalry - Moyale
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- In the past week, fighting triggered by a dispute over the display of the Somali Regional State flag in Ethiopia's southern border town, Moyale, spread across seven districts over the weekend, leaving deaths, injuries, and property destruction in its wake. Reports indicate that tens of thousands of people have also fled across the border into Kenya in search of safety.

title: All of Africa Today - October 28, 2026
summary: [allAfrica]

title: Peace-Security Anchor Ethiopia Must Consolidate Commitments to Peace and Security - Former PM
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Ethiopia, which remains an anchor for peace and security in the region, must strengthen and continue this genuine commitment to peace, former Ethiopian Prime Minister Hailemariam Desalegn told ENA.

title: Somaliland Joins Ethiopian Navy's Red Sea Workshop
summary: [Horn Diplomat] Addis Ababa -- Somaliland is among the participants in a four-day regional maritime security workshop hosted by the Ethiopian Navy in Addis Ababa, bringing together naval and maritime representatives from Yemen, Oman, Djibouti and Puntland to strengthen cooperation across the Red Sea, Gulf of Aden and western Indian Ocean.

title: Ethiopia Working to Become Continental Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Says Health State Minister
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Ethiopia is striving to become a continental pharmaceutical manufacturing hub by leveraging the African Continental Free Trade Area, regional value chains, regulatory cooperation, and pooled procurement to expand African-made health products and position, Health State Minister Dr. Muluken Argaw said.

title: UN Reports 36,000 Ethiopian Arrivals Fleeing Moyale Conflict, Kenya Rights Commission Urges Aid
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Approximately 36,000 people have crossed from Ethiopia into Kenya to flee conflict in and around Moyale, with food, clean water, shelter, sanitation, and healthcare identified as the most urgent needs, the UN Refugee Agency (UNHCR) in Kenya said.

title: Drought, Food Shortages and Child Malnutrition Deepen Humanitarian Needs in Afar, Amhara and Tigray
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Drought, rising food prices, shortages of essential medicines and disruptions to health services are compounding humanitarian needs across northern Ethiopia's Afar, Amhara and Tigray regions, with displaced children particularly vulnerable to acute malnutrition, according to a humanitarian assessment document seen by Addis Standard.
